meaning: Recorded full-run measurements of the launchable protocols. Smoke subsets have no performance target. These values are not an assertion that the paper's unpublished reference configurations were reproduced.

perception-test.protocol: Public validation MCQ; 16 source-cut-aware images; aspect-preserving maximum side 768; temperature 0, seed 1, thinking disabled; local top1.
perception-test.paper_note: No Perception Test reference in the cited Cosmos3 reasoner table; this is a measured launchable baseline, not published-Cosmos-score reproduction.
perception-test.verification: Complete coverage and independent label/score reduction; identical offline rescore. Historical measurement, not a fresh-VM timing.

videophy2.protocol: 32 frames at 224x224; temperature 0, seed 42, thinking disabled; categorical 1-5 ratings; mean semantic-alignment/physical-commonsense Pearson correlation times 100; audited visual input.
videophy2.paper_note: Numeric difference is in correlation points, not accuracy percentage points. Exact paper prompt, preprocessing and scalar-rating conversion have not been confirmed.
videophy2.verification: Complete coverage; independent centered-covariance reduction. Earlier incorrect four-frame diagnostics were excluded.

mmsivideo-bench.protocol: Uniform-50 canonical frames plus references; maximum processor pixels 151200; temperature 0, seed 1; 2048 output tokens; official pinned local answer extractor; invalid/truncated outputs included.
mmsivideo-bench.paper_note: Close numerically, but the paper's exact frame/pixel/generation/scoring configuration is not public in the cited table; no identical-reference-protocol claim.
mmsivideo-bench.verification: Complete coverage; official scorer CLI and independent count reduction agree. Eight invalid answers, including seven truncated responses, remain counted.
